newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST-BES H1 cons net seen higher.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-BES H1 cons net seen higher.

text.p: Portuguese bank Banco Espirito Santo is expected to boost its six-month consolidated net profit to between 13 and 15 billion escudos from 10.7 billion in the same period last year, analysts said.
They said the results, due to be announced tomorrow, were explained by increases in commissions, profit margins and trading gains and that they expected the bank to boost deposits and loans.

"BES should have closed the first half of 1997 with a net profit of between 14 and 15 billion escudos, considering the strong increase in commissions and an improvement in profit margins," said an analyst who asked not to be identified.
Four brokers and banks polled by Reuters forecast that BES would post a net profit of between 20 and 27.2 billion escudos in 1997 and between 23 and 31.3 billion in 1998.

"I expect BES will make a profit for the first half of more than 14 billion escudos, with commissions showing a clear improvement and trading gains much better than in the first quarter," said another analyst who asked not to be identified.
In the first quarter, BES's consolidated net profit was about seven billion escudos, clients' deposits were about three trillion escudos and loans more than 1.5 trillion.
"BES has shown improved efficiency in various services via the control of costs and trading gains, and so we are expecting a good first half, as in the first quarter," a third analyst said.
